checks: The envelope gap is affine for each fixed normal and nonnegative on the whole source hull. The exponential tests are globally convex, continuous and uniformly dominated on that hull.

The perspective is convex on the positive affine domain. Compactness inside that domain bounds its subgradients there, so the supremum of its supporting functions at hull points is a finite global convex extension agreeing on the hull.

The positive-part tests using the extension are nonnegative and globally convex. On the hull their pointwise limit is the perspective times the contact indicator, under a uniform bound. Integrability of Xi justifies both dominated-convergence steps.

Continuous bounded approximants to a single facet normal legitimately isolate its normal atom. Homothety scales facet area by ell^{d-1}; the perspective factor gives ell^d and the signed response remains evaluated on each fiber.
